    //==
    // # Function-valued fields
    //
    // Evaluation of a field that STORES a function: invoke the stored function.
    // This is the base case that makes the combinators below possible — each one
    // builds a new field whose stored function closes over the operand fields.

    // The stored function applied to the position.
    Eval(self: ScalarFunctionField2D, point: Point2D): Number
        => self.Function(point);

    // The stored function applied to the position.
    Eval(self: ScalarFunctionField3D, point: Point3D): Number
        => self.Function(point);

    // The stored function applied to the position.
    Eval(self: VectorFunctionField2D, point: Point2D): Vector2D
        => self.Function(point);

    // The stored function applied to the position.
    Eval(self: VectorFunctionField3D, point: Point3D): Vector3D
        => self.Function(point);

    //==
    // # Lifting any field into function-valued form
    //
    // One interface-typed function per family lifts EVERY implementor of that field
    // interface — constant fields, metaball systems, sampled SDFs, noise, and the
    // function-valued fields themselves — into the combinator algebra below.
    //
    // Each is named after its return type, so each is an IMPLICIT conversion: the
    // lifted field evaluates to the same value at every point as the field it came
    // from, nothing is sampled or approximated, and no parameter is invented
    // (Convention: see CONVENTIONS.md - Conversions).

    // The field as a function-valued planar scalar field, holding a lambda that
    // evaluates this field.
    ScalarFunctionField2D(self: IScalarField2D): ScalarFunctionField2D
        => ScalarFunctionField2D(p => self.Eval(p));

    // The field as a function-valued spatial scalar field, holding a lambda that
    // evaluates this field.
    ScalarFunctionField3D(self: IScalarField3D): ScalarFunctionField3D
        => ScalarFunctionField3D(p => self.Eval(p));

    // The field as a function-valued planar vector field.
    VectorFunctionField2D(self: IVectorField2D): VectorFunctionField2D
        => VectorFunctionField2D(p => self.Eval(p));

    // The field as a function-valued spatial vector field.
    VectorFunctionField3D(self: IVectorField3D): VectorFunctionField3D
        => VectorFunctionField3D(p => self.Eval(p));

    //==
    // # Scalar field combinators
    //
    // Pointwise composition. Every combinator returns a NEW field holding the
    // composed lambda; nothing is evaluated until the result is sampled. Combine
    // is the primitive — the rest are one-liners over it.

    // Two fields merged pointwise by a binary operator.
    Combine(a: ScalarFunctionField2D, b: ScalarFunctionField2D, op: Function2<Number, Number, Number>): ScalarFunctionField2D
        => ScalarFunctionField2D(p => op(a.Eval(p), b.Eval(p)));

    // Two fields merged pointwise by a binary operator.
    Combine(a: ScalarFunctionField3D, b: ScalarFunctionField3D, op: Function2<Number, Number, Number>): ScalarFunctionField3D
        => ScalarFunctionField3D(p => op(a.Eval(p), b.Eval(p)));

    // The field with its output value transformed by f (a range warp).
    MapValue(self: ScalarFunctionField2D, f: Function1<Number, Number>): ScalarFunctionField2D
        => ScalarFunctionField2D(p => f(self.Eval(p)));

    // The field with its output value transformed by f (a range warp).
    MapValue(self: ScalarFunctionField3D, f: Function1<Number, Number>): ScalarFunctionField3D
        => ScalarFunctionField3D(p => f(self.Eval(p)));

    // The field with its input position transformed by f before evaluation (a
    // domain warp): bending, twisting, tiling, and instancing are all domain warps.
    MapDomain(self: ScalarFunctionField2D, f: Function1<Point2D, Point2D>): ScalarFunctionField2D
        => ScalarFunctionField2D(p => self.Eval(f(p)));

    // The field with its input position transformed by f before evaluation.
    MapDomain(self: ScalarFunctionField3D, f: Function1<Point3D, Point3D>): ScalarFunctionField3D
        => ScalarFunctionField3D(p => self.Eval(f(p)));

    // The sum of two fields, pointwise.
    Add(a: ScalarFunctionField2D, b: ScalarFunctionField2D): ScalarFunctionField2D
        => a.Combine(b, (x, y) => x + y);

    // The sum of two fields, pointwise.
    Add(a: ScalarFunctionField3D, b: ScalarFunctionField3D): ScalarFunctionField3D
        => a.Combine(b, (x, y) => x + y);

    //==
    // # Constructive solid geometry on distance fields
    //
    // SDF convention: union is the pointwise minimum, intersection the maximum,
    // difference the left field against the negated right
    // (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Constructive_solid_geometry). Fidelity
    // (`implicit-sdf.concepts.plato`), for exact operands: union is exact,
    // everything else here is a lower bound. Nothing in this section can turn a
    // bound into a non-bound.

    // The union of two planar distance fields: the pointwise minimum. Exact.
    Union(a: ScalarFunctionField2D, b: ScalarFunctionField2D): ScalarFunctionField2D
        => a.Combine(b, (x, y) => x.Min(y));

    // The union of two spatial distance fields: the pointwise minimum. Exact.
    Union(a: ScalarFunctionField3D, b: ScalarFunctionField3D): ScalarFunctionField3D
        => a.Combine(b, (x, y) => x.Min(y));

    // The intersection of two planar distance fields: the pointwise maximum. A
    // lower bound.
    Intersection(a: ScalarFunctionField2D, b: ScalarFunctionField2D): ScalarFunctionField2D
        => a.Combine(b, (x, y) => x.Max(y));

    // The intersection of two spatial distance fields: the pointwise maximum. A
    // lower bound.
    Intersection(a: ScalarFunctionField3D, b: ScalarFunctionField3D): ScalarFunctionField3D
        => a.Combine(b, (x, y) => x.Max(y));

    // The first field with the second carved out of it: a against the negated b.
    // A lower bound.
    Difference(a: ScalarFunctionField2D, b: ScalarFunctionField2D): ScalarFunctionField2D
        => a.Combine(b, (x, y) => x.Max(y.Negative));

    // The first field with the second carved out of it: a against the negated b.
    // A lower bound.
    Difference(a: ScalarFunctionField3D, b: ScalarFunctionField3D): ScalarFunctionField3D
        => a.Combine(b, (x, y) => x.Max(y.Negative));

    // The union of two spatial distance fields blended over blendRadius: the
    // polynomial smooth minimum. A lower bound.
    // Precondition: blendRadius is positive.
    SmoothUnion(a: ScalarFunctionField3D, b: ScalarFunctionField3D, blendRadius: Number): ScalarFunctionField3D
        => a.Combine(b, (x, y) => SmoothUnionDistance(x, y, blendRadius));

    // The field grown (positive amount) or shrunk (negative amount) by a constant
    // distance: the offset surface of a distance field. Exact; at worst a lower
    // bound where a negative amount erodes a feature away entirely.
    Offset(self: ScalarFunctionField2D, amount: Number): ScalarFunctionField2D
        => self.MapValue(x => x - amount);

    // The field grown (positive amount) or shrunk (negative amount) by a constant.
    // Exact, with the same erosion caveat as the planar form.
    Offset(self: ScalarFunctionField3D, amount: Number): ScalarFunctionField3D
        => self.MapValue(x => x - amount);

    // The complement of a distance field: inside and outside swapped. Exact — only
    // the sign changes.
    Complement(self: ScalarFunctionField2D): ScalarFunctionField2D
        => self.MapValue(x => x.Negative);

    // The complement of a distance field: inside and outside swapped. Exact.
    Complement(self: ScalarFunctionField3D): ScalarFunctionField3D
        => self.MapValue(x => x.Negative);
